projects.title: Open-plan tech floor
projects.lead: A full-floor workplace for a fast-growing product team, planned around neighbourhoods rather than rows.
projects.body: Each team gets its own cluster of workstations, a writable wall and a nearby huddle space. A central café spine connects them and doubles as the floor's town-hall space. Acoustic baffles, phone booths and a quiet library edge keep focus work possible in an open plan.

projects.title: Private bank boardroom
projects.lead: A boardroom suite for a private bank that needed to feel discreet, warm and technically flawless.
projects.body: We designed a bespoke oak table with integrated power and conferencing, fluted acoustic wall panels that hide the AV equipment, and layered lighting that adjusts from presentation mode to evening dinners.

projects.title: Co-working café
projects.lead: A members' café that works as a coffee bar by day, hot-desking by afternoon and an event space after hours.
projects.body: Mobile furniture, a long communal bar and banquette seating let the operator reset the room in minutes. A bold colour palette and pendant lighting give the space a hospitality feel that sets it apart from the rest of the building.

projects.title: Corporate HQ reception
projects.lead: An arrival experience for a corporate headquarters, built around a sculpted reception desk and a backlit brand wall.
projects.body: We reworked the ground-floor lobby to separate visitor arrival, security and a hospitality lounge without losing the double-height openness. Stone, timber and warm lighting carry the brand from the entrance to the lifts.

projects.title: Startup breakout lounge
projects.lead: Soft seating, a library wall and planted corners that give a busy startup somewhere to slow down.
projects.body: The brief was a space people choose over their desks. Zoned rugs, mixed seating heights and a bookshelf partition create small settings inside one room, from a quick stand-up to an afternoon of reading.

projects.title: Specialist clinic
projects.lead: A calm, daylight-led clinic designed around patient flow, privacy and easy-clean finishes.
projects.body: Clear sightlines from the front desk, separate in and out routes and a palette of soft greens and timber reduce anxiety for patients. Every finish was specified for durability and infection control without looking clinical.
